JOIN US AS F&B ATTENDANT AT HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS AMSTERDAM NORTH RIVERSIDE!THE POSITIONWe're searching for enthusiastic teammates that enjoy working in fast-paced workplaces and have a strong desire to provide outstanding customer service. With a spacious terrace and city views, Holiday Inn Express Almere , can be enjoyed at the restaurant on the ground floor or having a drink at the bar. You will also have the chance to enjoy from our international menu, amazing and delicious dishes and fresh cocktails from the bar. If it is sunny outside, you can relax on the large terrace.YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Work in the bar, restaurant, and breakfast for table service.
• Assist in the preparation of the place for service as required, in accordance with the required hotel standards.
• Promote hospitality within our hotel standards.WHAT YOU'LL BRING
• Are passionate about providing an exceptional guest experience and living through our brand standards.
• Have a creative and warm personality and know how to connect everyone and everything.
• Are representative and guest oriented.
• Speak excellent English, Dutch language is a plus.
• Experience with Hospitality is a plus.
WHY THIS ROLE AT ODYSSEY?
• Industry leading salary;
• Attractive benefit package;
• Opportunity to take part in a collective health insurance;
• Employee rates within IHG and Odyssey Hotel Group hotels;
• Fresh and healthy staff lunch/ dinner, prepared by our Kitchen team;
• An international team and dynamic work environment.
• We care for you and via Empowr. we aim to foster your personal well-being with diverse resources.
INTERESTED?Please apply via this vacancy and our colleagues from the Talent team will contact you as soon as possible.We look forward to receiving your application!
